title: Technical drawings - Representation of splines and serrations
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13088) covers Technical drawings - Representation of splines and serrations. This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 6413 : 1988 'Technical drawings — Representation of splines and serrations' issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the Committee ( LMD 02 ) and approval of the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards; attention is especially drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use point ( . ) ^^ ^^^ decimal marker. in the adopted standard, reference appears to certain International Standards for which Indian Standards also exist. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
